2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. The rollback succeeded — all three regions now report v2.3.0 with status `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged. (Note: the first attempt timed out, so I verified via `list_incidents` that nothing was created and retried successfully.)

No approval was needed since this was a rollback to a previously healthy production version, not a new deploy.
